en.description: Every pattern the factory can assemble a prototype from, running on one page: landing, Google sign-in, dashboard, records grid and a map.

landing.headline: Every pattern, running
landing.subheadline: This is the template a prototype is assembled from. Each pattern below is real code, not a mockup — sign in and the dashboard, grid and map are all live.

features.title: Patterns, not templates
features.description: A prototype enables the patterns its idea needs. Nothing is deleted or generated — the config switches them on.

features.title: Fifteen palettes, one build
features.description: Every scheme ships in every build. Press Change colour in the header and the whole page repaints.

features.title: Sign-in that works
features.description: Google authentication and a route guard are part of the template, so a prototype has real accounts on day one.

howItWorks.heading: How do you try the prototype?

steps.title: Explore the landing
steps.description: Scroll through the chapters to see the enabled patterns.

steps.title: Sign in with Google
steps.description: Open the dashboard with your own account.

steps.title: Try your own records
steps.description: Add and edit records in your private sandbox.

faq.heading: What should you know before trying it?

items.question: Is this generated code?
items.answer: No. The prototype uses existing components enabled by a JSON configuration.

items.question: Where do the records live?
items.answer: Signed-in visitors work with their own records in a private Firestore sandbox.

items.question: Does the page work on a phone?
items.answer: Yes. Phones show the same chapters as a scrolling document. Desktop supports a sticky story stage.

cta.subtitle: Sign in to explore the dashboard and your own records.
